title: 14 Best Review Management Software Platforms for Agencies in 2026 - Swydo

facts.fact: BrightLocal's 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey, as cited by Swydo, reports that 96% of consumers read reviews before making a purchase decision.
facts.quote: 96% of consumers read reviews before making a purchase decision, and 83% use Google specifically.

facts.fact: BrightLocal's 2026 survey, as cited by Swydo, reports that 83% of consumers use Google specifically for reviews.
facts.quote: 96% of consumers read reviews before making a purchase decision, and 83% use Google specifically.

facts.fact: Womply's analysis of 200,000 small businesses, as cited by Swydo, found that businesses responding to at least 25% of their reviews earn 35% more revenue than average.
facts.quote: Womply’s analysis of 200,000 small businesses found that businesses responding to at least 25% of their reviews earn 35% more revenue than average

facts.fact: Womply's analysis, as cited by Swydo, found that businesses rated 4.0–4.5 stars earn 28% more than the average business.
facts.quote: businesses rated 4.0–4.5 stars earn 28% more than the average business.

facts.fact: Vendasta's churn study of 130,000+ SMB accounts, as cited by Swydo, found agencies whose clients use reputation management software see 57% higher client retention than agencies that don't offer the service.
facts.quote: agencies whose clients use reputation management software see 57% higher client retention compared to agencies that don’t offer the service.

facts.fact: The FTC's Final Rule on fake reviews carries fines of $53,088 per violation, applied per review rather than per campaign.
facts.quote: Fines are $53,088 per violation — per review, not per campaign.

facts.fact: Swydo states that review gating, meaning sending only happy customers to Google, is explicitly banned under the FTC's rule.
facts.quote: Review gating — only sending happy customers to Google — is explicitly banned.

facts.fact: According to Swydo's citation of BrightLocal, 74% of consumers only care about reviews from the last three months.
facts.quote: 74% of consumers only care about reviews from the last three months.

facts.fact: Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors, as cited by Swydo, puts reviews at roughly 20% of local pack ranking factors.
facts.quote: reviews account for roughly 20% of local pack ranking factors per Whitespark’s 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors.

facts.fact: BrightLocal's 2026 survey, as cited by Swydo, reports that 83% of consumers who are asked to leave a review do so.
facts.quote: 83% of consumers who are asked to leave a review do so.

facts.fact: GatherUp's November 2024 data, as cited by Swydo, shows SMS-only review requests yield about 20 reviews per 100 requests.
facts.quote: | SMS only | ~20 | Seen faster, higher open rate |

facts.fact: GatherUp's November 2024 data, as cited by Swydo, shows email-only review requests yield about 15 reviews per 100 requests.
facts.quote: | Email only | ~15 | More detail, lower urgency |

facts.fact: GatherUp's November 2024 data, as cited by Swydo, shows an SMS plus email sequence yields about 26 reviews per 100 requests, which Swydo says is 73% more than email alone.
facts.quote: | SMS + Email sequence | ~26 | 73% more than email alone |
